_about: Scheduled tasks the AI Dev Office runs on its own clock. Routines fire via src/when.js and run through our Groq-powered askX().

routines.title: Weekly security sweep
routines.text: Review this week's merged PRs (if any are in the Brain) for new security issues. Focus on OWASP A01-A10 patterns. Draft a short memo (<300 words) with 'Critical / High / Medium' sections and send to Alex for the final call.

routines.title: Daily code-health digest
routines.text: Summarise what the code review crew did yesterday (reviews completed, verdicts, top issues). 5 bullets max. Save to the Brain as a dated note.
